Use Astra as the base, graft Sol’s single exhaustive `definition()` match, and retain Astra’s derived `EnumIter` and private static `PreferredFunderName`.

Scores across removal, preservation, vocabulary, and simplicity:

| Candidate | Score |
|---|---:|
| Astra | 39/40 |
| Sol | 37/40 |
| Luna | 36/40 |

The synthesis removes decoder machinery, keeps each family’s metadata together, and avoids a manually duplicated registry. Preserve explicit lexical sorting of conflict keys. Replace schema/version tests with coherence checks, actual-spelling behavior coverage, and an alias-only negative test.
